description: MiMo-Audio: Audio Language Models are Few-Shot Learners

summary.one_liner: MiMo-Audio is Xiaomi's open audio language model project (7B base and instruct variants plus a 1.2B audio tokenizer) that aims to do few-shot audio tasks via in-context learning.
summary.what_it_does: The repository releases three Hugging Face models: MiMo-Audio-Tokenizer, MiMo-Audio-7B-Base, and MiMo-Audio-7B-Instruct. The tokenizer is a 1.2B-parameter Transformer at 25 Hz with an eight-layer RVQ stack, and the model couples a patch encoder, an LLM, and a patch decoder to bridge speech and text sequence lengths. The README describes the base model's few-shot and in-context learning on audio tasks, including voice conversion, style transfer, speech editing, and speech continuation, and the instruct model's audio understanding, spoken dialogue, and instruct-TTS abilities. It includes a local Gradio demo launched by run_mimo_audio.py and two inference example scripts, one for the base model and one for the instruct model. A separate MiMo-Audio-Eval toolkit is referenced for evaluation.
use_cases: run few-shot audio tasks with an audio language model
interactive speech and audio understanding demo
how_to_run: git clone <repo URL> && cd MiMo-Audio && pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install flash-attn==2.7.4.post1
notable: Few-shot and in-context learning on audio tasks, including tasks absent from training such as voice conversion and speech editing
Patch encoder downsamples 25 Hz RVQ tokens to 6.25 Hz for the LLM, with a delayed-generation patch decoder restoring full resolution
Base and instruct model variants, with instruct adding thinking mechanisms for audio understanding and generation
Built-in Gradio demo for local interactive use
caveats: Requires Linux, Python 3.12, and CUDA >= 12.0 per the README
flash-attn compilation can be slow; a precompiled wheel is suggested as a workaround
Large pretraining scale (over one hundred million hours) and 7B models imply substantial hardware needs; the README does not state minimum GPU memory
Use restrictions prohibit military use, malicious cyber activity, and unauthorized personal data processing
